label: De Eendracht (1990, Marga Klompélaan / J.G. Suurhoffstraat) terraced house: pale buff brick over a dark brick plinth, white render panel between the stacked 2-light windows, teal door beside a grey panel in a shared recessed porch, dark tile gable roof with paired black vent pipes, mirrored pairs

chimneys.note: black vent pipe on the front slope just below the ridge, over the door bay (two per house)

evidence.note: 2022-04-12 08:07, sun 115/29 on the east front, ~70 px/m on the 5.12 m house between party walls (u from the window side): 2-light window 0.79-2.5 m, sill 0.6, head 2.43 under a dark roller-shutter box; white render panel the window's width up to the upper sill (3.64 m); upper 2-light 0.85-2.45 m, h 1.62, shutter box over it; teal door 3.36-4.07 m (h 2.2) and a light grey panel 4.21-4.86 m in a porch shared with the mirrored neighbour, dark lintel at ~2.43 m, white pier between the two porches; 1-light window 3.86-4.57 m (sill 3.57, h 1.5) over the door; eaves ~5.6 m; two black vent pipes near the ridge. Layout measured on the sunlit 2022-04-12 crop of 2123026; colours: the sunlit buff brick clips, so the wall tint sits between that and the white-referenced overcast reading (2114756, 2017). Tile and door from the sunlit crop, plinth white-referenced.

The vent pipes are drawn as two thin dark chimney stacks over the door bay. Occasional rear dormers, the one or two rooflights on some houses, the canopies some owners added over the ground window and the garden sheds are not modelled.
The P. Lieftinckstraat rows of the same year (4.5 m frontage, low front eaves with a two-storey box over the window half) are their own design (nw-ee-box-front).
